headerDisplay: Controls a MrCool/Cielo mini split through Cielo's cloud API (login used is the same one your Cielo Home / MRCOOL SmartHVAC app uses).

macAddress.title: Dongle MAC Address (optional)
macAddress.description: MAC address of one specific Cielo device to control, e.g. c4:d8:d5:18:b6:43. Leave blank to auto-register every device found on your Cielo account as its own accessory.
